Henry Belasyse and Grace Barton.2,3 He married, firstly, Mildred Saunderson, daughter of Nicholas Saunderson, 2nd Viscount Castleton and Frances Manners, on 3 July 1651.3 He married, secondly, Mary Cromwell, daughter of Oliver Cromwell and Elizabeth Bouchier.
